description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a growing BC-based hot pot chain offering a self-serve format with over 100 fresh ingredients and 18+ broth options, including Signature Mala, Collagen Bone, and Tomato (vegan available). The New Westminster location occupies a second-floor unit at 800 Carnarvon Street, formerly the Hub Restaurant New West. Cyclists stopping here can expect a sit-down, indoor-only meal with no outdoor seating.
